description: This file defines the 'NotesService' class, a service responsible for managing notes with local persistence via shared_preferences and optional backend synchronization through an API client. It provides methods for creating, updating, deleting, and summarizing notes, handling fallback mechanisms when backend is unavailable.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: A service class for managing notes, with support for local storage, backend synchronization, and note summarization.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Initializes the service by checking backend availability and loading notes from the appropriate source.

methods.name: _loadFromLocal
methods.description: Loads notes from local storage using shared preferences.

methods.name: _loadFromBackend
methods.description: Fetches notes from the backend API.

methods.name: _saveToLocal
methods.description: Saves the current list of notes to local storage.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note, saving it to backend if available, otherwise locally.

methods.name: summarizeNote
methods.description: Generates a summary for a note, using backend service if available or local summarizer.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note, syncing with backend if available.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, reflecting the change in backend if available.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reinitializes the notes list by checking backend status and reloading notes.
